svg.title: Jatin Kumar Singh / Recognition and qualifications
svg.desc: Recognition: Winner, Eclipse 6.0 Hackathon; 2nd Place in the Security Domain, India Innovates; 2nd Runner-Up, Sprint4Good; 7th Place, GenCyS 2.0 CTF. Certified Red Team Professional from Altered Security. B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering, Cyber Security specialisation, The NorthCap University, expected 2027, CGPA 8.31. Original illustrative award objects. Official CRTP mark from Altered Security.
